TRACEABLE BY DESIGN

Audit & evidence.

Metrics are derived from recorded demo events, with their scope visible.

Analyze an exported audit trail

Import a full audit package to verify its SHA-256 chain and recalculate metrics. Maximum 2 MB. Imports are read-only; they never replace live data.

No imported package.

Hash chaining detects edits against the supplied chain. It is not a signature: someone can rebuild a chain. Browser storage is not tamper-resistant.

Measurement inputs

Recording a waiver does not bypass a release gate.

YOUR FIELD GUIDE

From registration
to reassessment.

Based on the supplied AI Governance Lab user manual. Follow the steps in the interactive portal.

01

Register an asset

Open Asset workspace. Keep the sample metadata or enter an asset name, owner, model version and purpose. Select any risk flags, then click Register asset. The selected asset shows its ID, risk and release state.

Start registration →
02

Test, approve and release

Run the passing demo suite. Review every required check, enter a demo reviewer and record human approval. Deploy the demo release. Try either failure button: new failing evidence revokes approval and runtime access. Recover by running the passing suite, approving and deploying again.

The original manual refers to LangFair counterfactual similarity and UQLM response consistency. This portal illustrates those checks with fixtures; it does not execute those libraries or certify a system.

03

Try runtime and agent controls

Select search and send a benefits question. Select propose_action to create a pending action, then approve its simulated execution. Try claims_write or injection to record a violation. Three violations open the circuit breaker. Deliberately redeploy the approved release to reset it.

04

Demonstrate reassessment

Apply a different model version under Material change. Existing evidence and approval are cleared, deployment is revoked and pending actions are discarded. Runtime stays blocked until testing, review and deployment are repeated.

05

Review and export evidence

Open Audit & evidence. Expand each metric definition to see its denominator. N/A means the required data is missing. Download the full audit package, then import it to verify the chain and recalculate metrics. The metrics-only export cannot be verified as an audit package.

Inspect the evidence →
06

Supply missing measurement data

Save eligible team IDs. Record when a synthetic incident occurred; detection time is captured when you submit it. Resolve an open incident to measure resolution latency. Add waiver references for visibility; they do not grant release approval.

Quick fixes

Runtime blocked? Check the selected asset, passing evidence, reviewer approval, release status and circuit breaker. Export rejected? Use the unedited full audit package. Browser data unavailable? Allow local storage; the portal reports persistence errors. All portal data is local to this browser and origin.
